My dear [Irene](/person/538),
Do you know your stamps never came out of your letter. I waited a day or two in case you had forgotten them and would find them out, but they are not forthcoming yet. I do not think I could have lost them in opening the letter.

Many thanks for them all the same.
[Chelsea Delf](/person/329) and you are the [winners](/topic/104) this time You for the compass
your affectionate
Mother Goose
Jany 2nd This letter got into another by mistake and has been to Edinburgh!
